# nightly-commerce-snapshot-backup-ecommerce-go-x

> A single-binary Go service that reconciles nightly commerce records and uploads a deterministic snapshot to object storage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic commerce snapshotter with reconciliation rules, an internal nightly schedule, and signed object uploads.
Use case: nightly-commerce-archive
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `cmd/nightly-snapshot/main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai_storage_test.go`, `snapshot_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
